leaves.name: outer_frame

leaves.name: cat_strip
leaves.note: The journal sub-tab selector, and the two apps do not draw the same KIND of thing here. Qud renders icon buttons -- a 'Q' keycap glyph followed by pictorial category icons in boxes. Raves renders the category WORDS ('Locations  Chronology  Gossip and Lore  Sultan His...'). That is why Qud's header band runs x190-906 against Raves' x190-589 and why Qud has a band at y211-217 that Raves has nothing for. Not a layout offset: a different widget. Scoring it is only meaningful once Raves draws icons.

leaves.name: worldmap
leaves.note: The world-map panel, found as the large near-black rect inside the pane.
